'''2007 Worlds Day 2 Chris Menzel DS Ralltiir Operations''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Chris Menzel]] at [[2007 World Championship]] (Day 2).


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Chris Menzel]]
* '''Event:''' [[2007 World Championship]]
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS13]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Ralltiir Operations / In The Hands Of The Empire|SE-D-ralltiiroperations.gif|label=Ralltiir Operations}}
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
